name: External Document Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the document type as published in an external document type code list.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

CNFA.name: Credit Note Related To Financial Adjustment
CNFA.definition: Document is a credit note for the final amount settled for a commercial transaction.

CONT.name: Contract
CONT.definition: Document is a contract evidencing an agreement between the seller and buyer for the supply of goods and/or services.

DISP.name: Dispatch Advice
DISP.definition: Document is an advice of dispatch of the goods.

DNFA.name: Debit Note Related To Financial Adjustment
DNFA.definition: Document is a debit note for the final amount settled for a commercial transaction.

HIRI.name: Hire Invoice
HIRI.definition: Document is an invoice for the hiring of human resources or renting goods or equipment.

MSIN.name: Metered Service Invoice
MSIN.definition: Document is an invoice claiming payment for the supply of metered services, eg. Gas or electricity, supplied to a fixed meter.

PROF.name: Proforma Invoice
PROF.definition: In trade transactions, a pro forma invoice is a document that states a commitment from the seller to sell goods to the buyer at specified prices and terms. It is used to declare the value of the trade. It is not a true invoice, because it is not used to record accounts receivable for the seller and accounts payable for the buyer.

QUOT.name: Quotation
QUOT.definition: Document is a quotation setting out the conditions under which the goods and/or services are offered.

SBIN.name: Self Billed Invoice
SBIN.definition: Document is a statement of the transactions posted to the debtor's account at the supplier.

SPRR.name: Seller Presentment
SPRR.definition: Document is a document presented by the seller in support of the procurement of goods and/or services.

TISH.name: Time Sheet
TISH.definition: Document is a timesheet recording times for the provision of services and/or delivery of goods.

USAR.name: Usage Report
USAR.definition: Document is a usage report indicating the consumption pattern for designated goods and/or services.

AROI.name: Account Receivable Open Item
AROI.definition: Document is a payment that applies to a specific source document.

CMCN.name: Commercial Contract
CMCN.definition: Document is an agreement between the parties, stipulating the terms and conditions of the delivery of goods or services.

SOAC.name: Statement Of Account
SOAC.definition: Document is a statement of the transactions posted to the debtor's account at the supplier.

TSUT.name: Trade Services Utility Transaction
TSUT.definition: Document is a transaction identifier as assigned by the Trade Services Utility.

VCHR.name: Voucher
VCHR.definition: Document is an electronic payment document.
